name: Transfer funds between two shares for a member
goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE as the given operator, look up the member by member number, and start a funds transfer. The From Share and To Share fields are dropdowns whose options are share IDs (e.g. '100987-S0001'); select exactly the given from_share and to_share values by their share ID, not by guessing a product name. Fill in the amount and memo as given. Go through the review step, confirm the details shown match what was entered, read the hidden per-transaction security token off the page, then post the transfer. This action is irreversible once posted. Read back the confirmation reference after posting.

inputs.name: from_share
inputs.description: Share ID to transfer from (as shown in the From Share dropdown, e.g. '100987-MMKT-11').

inputs.name: to_share
inputs.description: Share ID to transfer to (as shown in the To Share dropdown, e.g. '100987-S0001-4').

business_outcomes.description: No member record matches the given member number.
The from-share does not have enough available balance — a legitimate rejection.
The transfer form rejected the submitted values.
The source share is on HOLD and cannot be debited — a legitimate business-rule rejection, not a system failure.
